about_the_game:
The Mana Melody Woven by Humans and Elementals.

The original sound track of brand new title from Mana series, Visions of Mana, is available now!

Notable composers from the series, including Hiroki Kikuta, Tsuyoshi Sekito, and Ryo Yamazaki, have come together to create a grand selection of 100 tracks from "Visions of Mana".

Immerse yourself in this new melodies of Mana, centered around "Seiken" and "Mana," with love as its primary theme.

*This soundtrack is the same as the soundtrack included in the Visions of Mana Collector's Edition.
